description: This file defines the BufferSliceReaderInput struct, which provides input functionality to a reader that operates on BufferSlice buffers within the Orleans.Serialization.Buffers.Adaptors namespace. It includes methods for retrieving the next span of data, forking the input at a given position, and internal properties for accessing buffer state.

classes.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
classes.description: A struct that provides input operations for reading from BufferSlice buffers, with internal state management and methods for retrieving spans of data.

methods.name: BufferSliceReaderInput
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the input with a given BufferSlice.

methods.name: ForkFrom
methods.description: Creates a new BufferSliceReaderInput forked from a specified position within the buffer.

methods.name: GetNext
methods.description: Retrieves the next span of bytes from the buffer, handling segment traversal and buffer boundaries.
